scope: All PN panel image elaboration and revision tasks
authority_role: Process directive for image elaboration; engineering data remains authoritative in project-controlled sources.
core_rules: MODEL 001 defines visual/document structure, not target-panel physical size.
Target enclosure size is derived from target engineering content and frozen in target datasheet before render.
Side 3/4 view dimensions only the real target enclosure depth on the real depth axis.
Never distort geometry to fit the page; grow the canvas.
Synchronize Data Center and memory after approved visual changes.
Step 5 produces only the physical PN image set; Step 6 adds legend, panel data, electrical architecture, communication architecture, command diagram and dimensions.
Door/tampa geometry is invariant across angles and may only undergo rigid hinge rotation.
Step 6 dimensions are sourced from controlled H/W/D values, never inferred from raster/perspective.

step5.rule: One canonical assembly and same door geometry across all angles.

step6.rule: Compose frozen Step 5 physical image with legend/data/electrical/communication/command/dimensions using grow-only canvas.
